Schedules.name: Little Library open
Schedules.notes: Opens at 10:00 Tuesday to Sunday, except Christmas Day.

Schedules.name: Song Book start
Schedules.notes: START TIME NOT CONFIRMED - placeholder set to match Museum open (10:00). Confirm the real time before ticking Enabled. Plays the 'Kuarna Song Book' playlist saved in the dashboard's Media Player tab. The argument IS the playlist name - rename the playlist in the Media Player tab and this must be updated to match. Reaches the mpv engine via LTL-LIB-MEDIA-SCHEDULE. Enable 'Song Book stop' at the same time as this one.

Schedules.name: Song Book stop
Schedules.notes: Stops mpv at end of day. No argument. Without this the playlist keeps looping after hours.
